interest: Japan's 1939 registration of foreign-born Nisei, with a translated 'List of the Second Generation' questionnaire.
overview: Consul Richard F. Boyce's September 1939 Yokohama despatch on Japan's registration of foreign-national residents of Japanese ancestry, with the translated questionnaire 'List of the Second Generation.'

subfiles.about: Despatch reporting the Japanese government's registration of foreign-born residents of Japanese race to identify potential military conscripts and prevent espionage.
subfiles.summary: Boyce reports Japan registered foreign-national residents of Japanese race, mostly U.S.-born, to find dual citizens for service and guard against espionage.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 556 from Richard F. Boyce on Japanese Government's Special Registration of Foreigners of Japanese Race

subfiles.about: English translation of the questionnaire issued by Japanese authorities to register second-generation foreign-born persons of Japanese descent.
subfiles.summary: Translated Japanese registration form 'List of the Second Generation' for foreign-national residents of Japanese ancestry.
subfiles.title: Questionnaire: List of the Second Generation
subfiles.to: Foreigners of Japanese race / Second Generation residents

subfiles.about: Department of State cross-reference sheet indexing a document concerning the control and status of persons under Japanese law.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference sheet, file 894.01272, with a fragmentary note on control of persons under Japanese law.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference File Sheet on Control of Persons Under Japanese Law
